note: A readable dog cannot fit inside the kennel: an outlined side-view dog (body band, legs and head each >= 8 wide with holes >= 6) needs about 36x28 on its own, and the kennel wall, roof and floor take 8 more on three sides. The stick-figure dog that fits (uploaded attempt) reads as a stool; the rejected outline read as a zigzag.
